blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items:  Objective: Insurance coverage and financial support to farmers against crop loss due to natural
 Coverage: Food crops, oilseeds, horticultural, and commercial crops.
 Premium Rates (Farmer's Share): Rabi – 1.5%, Kharif – 2%, Horticulture/ Commercial – 5%.
 Key Features: "One State, One Insurance Company." Remote sensing, GPS, drones for
monitoring and faster claims. Voluntary for states since 2020.
 Tagline: Meri Policy Mere Haath (My Policy in My Hand).
 Scale: World's 3rd largest crop insurance scheme by premium volume.
